extracted text: AA2219 aluminum alloy plate (T87) and ring (T851) were joined by tungsten inert gas (TIG) welding. T87 temper condition: Solution treated at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + 7% stretched followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. T851 temper condition: Solution treated at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + stress relieved by 3% stretching followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. The rings underwent quench delay of 87 seconds before quenching in water after solution treatment.
property mapping:
- UTS (MPa) = Ultimate Tensile Strength in megapascals
- 0.2 pct YS (MPa) = 0.2% Yield Strength in megapascals
- Pct Elongation = Percent Elongation
- L = Longitudinal direction
- LT = Long Transverse direction
- C = Circumferential direction (for ring)
- R = Radial direction (for ring)
- A = Axial direction (for ring)
abbreviations:
- AA = Aluminum Association
- T87 = Solution treated, cold worked by 7% and artificially aged
- T851 = Solution treated, stress relieved by stretching (3%), and artificially aged
- TIG = Tungsten Inert Gas
- PP = Plate to Plate weld
- PR = Plate to Ring weld
- FZ = Fusion Zone
- BM = Base Metal
- bal. = balance (remainder of composition)
